root_cause.text: The `btusb` driver lacks bounds validation on the active SCO link count (`data->sco_num`) before using it to index the three-element `alts` array in `btusb_work()`, leading to an out-of-bounds read when more than three SCO links are active.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `new_alts = alts[data->sco_num - 1];` was replaced with a clamped index calculation using `min_t(unsigned int, data->sco_num - 1, ARRAY_SIZE(alts) - 1)` to ensure the index does not exceed the bounds of the `alts` array.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a boundary check to prevent out-of-bounds array access when selecting SCO alternate settings in btusb.
intent_record.what: Replaced direct indexing of the 'alts' array with a bounded index 'sco_idx' calculated using 'min_t' against 'ARRAY_SIZE(alts) - 1'.
intent_record.how: Prevents potential out-of-bounds memory access by ensuring the index used to access the 'alts' array does not exceed its maximum bounds.
